If you have an affinity for open source software, great communication skills, and a passion for troubleshooting and fixing issues in technology used by millions across the world, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

Our engineers are able to work productively at any level of the stack including the kernel and in a wide range of languages, to understand and address the software issues at hand. Our group is critical to the success of our customers, partners and Ubuntu itself.
You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software

Contamos com três Centros de Distribuição localizados no Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo e Belo Horizonte.

Nossa essência é carioca, com acolhimento genuíno e busca constante pela inovação. Valorizamos o capital humano, investimos na capacitação de nossos times e seguimos com ética, transparência e simplicidade. Aqui, cada cliente é prioridade e cada detalhe importa. A Venancio não para! Até o final de 2025, inauguraremos mais 23 lojas e continuaremos expandindo nossa presença no mercado, sempre buscando atendimento de excelência e soluções para o bem-estar de nossos clientes.

title: Associate Director of Creative (AI)
description:
We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it.

Darkroom is a progressive omnichannel growth marketing agency focused on retail, e-commerce, and consumer businesses. We have been recognized as one of the fastest growing private companies in America by Inc. ), a top 1% digital advertiser by Varos (2023), and our founders were named Forbes 30 Under 30 recipients for Marketing and Advertising North America (2024).

We are looking for an experienced and talented Associate Director of Creative to join our team.

The Associate Director of Creative is a player/coach designer who will work as a manager of a pod of Designers, as well as delivering your own AI-powered Creative Direction, Marketing Design, and UI/UX Design engagements at a high bar of client services and visual quality. You bring expertise in integrating AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Midjourney into your workflows to drive efficiency. You thrive on finding new ways to use AI to break barriers and being on the cutting edge of this paradigm shift.

In this role, you’ll report to the Director of Creative. You’ll use your strong design background to be an advocate for our design processes and philosophy, and supervise a small cohort of Designers by providing feedback on their work to develop their skillsets across paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e-commerce web design. Your main focus in the first 60 days will be helping the creative team integrate ChatGPT and AI into their work to discover and implement efficiencies. You’ll bring your expertise in AI workflows to help build processes and trainings with the Director of Creative. You’ll also be responsible for owning Creative Direction engagements that impact paid marketing and organic channels for e-commerce clients.

We’re looking for a candidate with deep experience in using AI to power their work at a commercial level, and who can apply this experience to the direction and development of junior designers. A strong candidate has a best-in-class visual eye, attention-to-detail, and client services acumen.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

Management Responsibilities:

  1. Manage a team of designers, starting with 1-2 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.

  2. Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.

  3. Ensure high-quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.

  4. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.

  5. Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities:

  1. Be a champion for AI-powered work, holding trainings on best practices for the team and building efficient workflows for the team in partnership with the Director of Creative.

  2. Lead Creative Direction engagements focused on transforming paid or organic marketing channels through deliverables like content calendars, creative briefs, and strategic proposals.

  3. Lead 1-2 UI/UX engagements as capacity allows, focusing on creating branded e-commerce websites. Emphasize branded UI, conversion-focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.

  4. Present design and creative direction work to clients, explaining choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.

  5. Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand-off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.

  6. Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:

  1. 3-6+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in creative direction, marketing design, or responsive web design.

  2. Digital portfolio showcasing web design, marketing design, and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.

  3. Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

  4. Experience working with AI tools and producing client-ready assets powered by AI outputs is required.

  5. Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand-off.

  6. Comfortable with client-facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.

  7. Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.

  8. Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.

  9. Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.

  10. Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.

A saudação #Sawabona se originou no Sul da África, onde se acredita que todos nascemos pessoas boas, mas que, às vezes, podemos cometer alguns erros.

Segundo a cultura deste lugar, quando alguém comete erros, toda a população se junta e, durante dois dias, só falam sobre as coisas boas que aquela pessoa já fez. Ao final desse período, todo o povo cumprimenta seu conterrâneo com a expressão Sawabona .

Esse, por sua vez, responde #Shikoba . Sendo assim, Sawabona significa: Eu te vejo, eu te respeito, você é importante para mim . E a resposta, Shikoba: Então eu sou bom e existo para você .

Aqui na Zappts, Sawabona traduz e representa o que mais prezamos em nossas relações: o respeito e a valorização do outro.

title: Inbound Sales Representative
description:
Join to apply for the Inbound Sales Representative role at Toptal

Join to apply for the Inbound Sales Representative role at Toptal

About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue

About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Job Summary:
Our Inbound Sales Representatives connect and engage with prospective clients who originate from inbound leads. They seek new business opportunities by connecting with, and developing relationships with, potential customers and guiding prospective clients throughout the required sales stages. To excel in this position, you need to effectively communicate and collaborate with clients, ensuring they understand the value of our services and how Toptal can support their goals. Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, is hungry to exceed sales quotas, and strives to go above and beyond. If you are passionate about sales, innately driven, and results-oriented, this is the perfect opportunity for you to launch your sales career.
This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Sales Cycle Management: You will be the initial face of Toptal and supporting our clients through the required sales stages. As the first point of contact and the initial ‘face’ of Toptal for new clients, you will be responsible for moving these clients forward in the sales process, starting with regularly conducting sales calls. You will be responsible for accurately articulating the benefit of Toptal to potential clients in these calls and managing deal cycles from discovery through close.
  • Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. You will be responsible for executing upon a customer-centric approach across all of your customer interactions during pre-defined working hours. You will build rapport with our prospective clients, which will require researching clients before outreach and staying on top of industry trends and Toptal competitors.
  • Collaboration with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team to promptly respond to high-volume inbound client inquiries. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB sales team members always look to improve individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical to achieving success in this role and at Toptal.
In the first week, expect to:
  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our team members, and our story.
  • Begin our 1-1 sales training process which conveys our value proposition, sales process, and delivery method.
  • Become acquainted with the cross-functional teams you will work with to close new business.
In the first month, expect to:
  • Complete our personalized sales training program, including mock calls and role-play scenarios.
  • Be able to accurately articulate Toptal’s value proposition and process.
  • Be able to speak to incoming leads, understand the clients’ needs, overcome any objections, present the value proposition of Toptal, and close leads that are a good fit for Toptal.
  • Work alongside the various business units to ensure your prospects are progressing through the funnel.
  • Begin closing new business, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
In the first three months, expect to:
  • Be fully ramped up and integrated into the team.
  • Complete additional vertical-specific training.
  • Possess a healthy pipeline of prospects that are working through your funnel.
  • Exhibit a successful track record of hitting sales goals.
In the first six months, expect to:
  • Have a solid history of claiming and closing new business by consistently meeting or exceeding sales goals.
  • Identify process improvement areas to help increase team efficiency and effectiveness, which may include providing consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures.
  • Continue to implement sales best practices for client interactions and follow-up.
In the first year, expect to:
  • Begin to mentor new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and pass along standard methodologies.
  • Continue to gain and close new business along with managing your funnel to consistently meet and exceed sales targets.
  • Become a productive, collaborative, and consistent contributor to the team.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • The ideal candidate has 1-3 years of B2B sales experience (i.e. Account Executive, Inside Sales, Outside Sales Representative, Account Representative, or related title).
  • Software or tech-related sales experience and education are a plus.
  • Be attentive to client needs. You will be required to be fully available during your working hours to take client calls.
  • You are client-centric. You will be working with prospective clients daily, uncovering and resolving clients’ issues through value-based selling.
  • Have a “will-to-win” attitude. You’re looking to not only meet but exceed your quota and are naturally competitive. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission and want our Client Advisors to make the most out of it!
  • You’re a “learn-it-all.” We are looking for someone who is always looking to grow, strives for improvement, and constantly seeks feedback from peers/ leaders. Even as an individual contributor, you seek to share and gain knowledge from those around you.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with your team members.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts. We move quickly, so having exceptional time management skills and the ability to manage a high volume of clients is key to being successful in this role.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

title: Junior Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include leading cloud and silicon providers and industry leaders across sectors. The company operates with a global distributed model, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times annually in person in various locations to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Every year we select new junior professionals into the Canonical Kernel Team to work on the Linux kernel for Ubuntu. If you enjoyed operating systems in your coursework or current role, are confident in your ability to write high quality C and possibly Rust, and are ready to take the plunge, this would be a great place to pursue your next career stage. We are a global team shipping the world’s most widely used Linux kernel across silicon and cloud, where you can apply and grow your software engineering skills.

The Canonical Kernel Team builds and maintains all supported Ubuntu Linux kernels for a variety of platforms and architectures, from small embedded devices to desktop/server systems to large-scale cloud environments. In your first year you will tackle serious initiatives, including but not limited to:

  • Optimized solutions for key Silicon and Cloud partner platforms
  • Developer platforms such as Raspberry Pi and RISC-V
  • Enabling Ubuntu on a wide range of embedded systems
  • Security hardening and exploit mitigation
  • Third-party driver integration and distribution, such as graphics
  • Expanded driver support for bleeding-edge PC platforms

We select candidates who are recent university graduates or early career professionals enthusiastic to develop kernel-level software in areas including security updates, patching, and testing. The successful candidate will have a software engineering background, be motivated to work in a distributed team, and be willing and able to travel globally twice a year for company engineering events. These are full-time positions available to prospective or recently graduated students.

Location: We have home-based Kernel Teams in every timezone.

The role entails

  • Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Learn from senior mentors to understand the inner workings of the Linux kernel and how it is distributed
  • Work closely with external silicon, cloud, or hardware manufacturer delivery teams on bleeding-edge platforms
  • Diagnose and resolve issues in the kernel reported by customers, the community, and those found by rigorous testing
  • Take personal responsibility for the delivery of various flavors of the Ubuntu Linux kernel
  • Improve tooling and automation for delivery and testing of Ubuntu Linux kernels
  • Submit, review, and apply kernel patches, working with internal and external upstream maintainers

What we are looking for in you

  • Well-organized and motivated self-starter able to thrive in a remote work environment
  • Professional manner with colleagues, business partners, and the open-source community
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and verbal
  • Programming experience in C and/or Rust
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git
  • Understanding of operating system kernel fundamentals
  • Ability to travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks in length

Nice-to-have skills

  • Interest and experience in Rust
  • Python and Bash scripting ability
  • Prior experience with Ubuntu/Debian/Snap packaging
  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSPs, and other low-level system engineering

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company behind Ubuntu, a key open-source project and platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we recruit on a global basis and maintain high standards. Most colleagues have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here challenges you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. We are hiring a Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems at Canonical
As a Project Manager for Canonical's Devices business, this role is responsible for the coordination and completion of large complex customer-facing projects, overseeing all aspects of project delivery and acting as the primary delivery liaison between Canonical's engineering teams and Canonical's customers.
You will be managing the projects that involve the delivery of Ubuntu images on a wide variety of devices ranging from robots, edge gateways, and IoT devices to PCs and automotive systems. This is a high-profile project management position where you are expected to build and maintain working relationships with team members, customers, other partners/vendors (Silicon vendors, OEMs, ODMs, IHVs), and other Canonical departments/teams.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the AMERICAs and/or EMEA regions.

  • Ensuring projects are delivered within the time/resources/scope expectations
  • Managing project risk mitigation and plans
  • Driving technical issues to reach desired delivery outcomes
  • Maintain daily and weekly communication with the client and all internal stakeholders
  • Managing delivery schedule of critical third-party deliverables for the project

  • Solid project management experience in delivering engineering services to customers managing software development teams and field engineers
  • Extensive experience successfully managing projects with cross-cultural and multi-continent internal and external project resources, preferably with resources in Asia, Europe, and the Americas
  • Educational degree preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math
  • Good knowledge of Linux and the wider Open Source Software community, and understanding of computer architecture
  • Excellent communications skills, both verbal and written, in English
  • Strong leader and problem solver with extensive experience building successful internal and external partnerships and effective working relationships with demanding project sponsors in complex organizational environments
  • PMP/PMI or PRINCE2 Practitioner Certification preferred

description:
Embedded IoT / Edge Solutions Sales Representative, Manager and Director

Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Embedded IoT / Edge Solutions Sales Representative, Manager and Director role at Canonical

Embedded IoT / Edge Solutions Sales Representative, Manager and Director

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Embedded IoT / Edge Solutions Sales Representative, Manager and Director role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring Embedded IoT / Edge Solutions Sales Representatives, Managers, and Directors to expand our reach in mission-critical industries such as Automotive, Medical Devices, Industrial Systems, Robotics, and Telco, as well as consumer electronics. We are looking for candidates who are technically skilled and familiar with embedded Linux and RTOS. We are expanding in all time zones, so we can accommodate candidates from almost any country as long as they have reasonable business access to a substantial market territory in person. As we grow our teams, we will also hire Sales Team Managers and Regional Sales Directors. Please continue with this process if your goal is a management leadership position.
The server edition of Ubuntu is already very widely used in connected devices and industrial PCs. Our newer edition of Ubuntu for IoT, called Ubuntu Core, represents the state of the art in security and resilience for high-end appliances and equipment. Our customers include global brands in consumer and industrial electronics, as well as automotive and robotics. We continue to expand our range of offerings to bring our security, management, and developer experience to the smallest Linux environments and devices. We recently added a real-time Linux capability and are working towards a range of certifications for these offerings. Together, this portfolio is Linux reinvented for optimal reliability, security, developer productivity, and footprint.
This is a prospecting sales and strategic account development role and requires energy, ambition, and focus. To be successful, you must be comfortable positioning and selling open source, services, and software solutions to all levels of an organization, and specifically to departments that are developing embedded software and IoT devices. You should also be familiar with at least one of our priority sectors.
Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute, and every category of application. Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting, and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote, and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.
We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position; it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision-making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long-term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world-leading company, we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment that promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration, and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.
In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers
Ubuntu is already very widely adopted, which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with brands in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement, and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgment as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete, and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.
The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies, and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.
Location: We are growing our sales reach in all regions - EMEA, APAC, and Americas.
The role entails
  • Building and executinge a territory plan to prioritize leading security-focused brands and manufacturers
  • Working with marketing to promote our brand and increase market awareness in prioritized accounts
  • Developing pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Closinge contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets and achieve strategic objectives
  • Managinge customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Working with IoT Field Engineers to understand customer requirements and ensure customer satisfaction
  • Maintaining accurate data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establishing productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision-makers
  • Coordinatinge with colleagues, including support, delivery, and management
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Field sales experience in embedded Linux, embedded software, or enterprise software
  • Track record of achievement of sales targets and large account wins
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% for customer meetings and industry events
  • Ability to develop and execute territory sales plans
  • Detail oriented with effective follow-up
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Já pensou em poder fazer parte de tudo isso?

Eternos ídolos já vestiram o Manto Sagrado, grandes craques formam nossas equipes, excelentes profissionais constroem a história de sucesso do Flamengo... O próximo pode ser você!

Para quem é craque do Mengão, não tem bola perdida: a gente entra firme na dividida e se destaca pelo profissionalismo. A busca é incessante pela excelência!

…AMOR E PAIXÃO!

Pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem e pelo Flamengo! Você verá que é muito fácil ter paixão pelo seu trabalho com a gente. Ética, transparência, honestidade, profissionalismo, respeito e integridade são titulares do nosso time em todas as partidas. Estamos sempre juntos com garra, otimismo e alegria para vencer!

Zelo pelas pessoas, desenvolvimento e constante aperfeiçoamento. Aqui no Flamengo, queremos ensinar, mas também aprender com você! Muitas são as oportunidades de evoluir com o espírito rubro-negro. Somos um time e uma família!

Embedded IoT / Edge Solutions Sales Representative, Manager and Director

Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring Embedded IoT / Edge Solutions Sales Representatives, Managers, and Directors to expand our reach in mission-critical industries such as Automotive, Medical Devices, Industrial Systems, Robotics, and Telco, as well as consumer electronics. We are looking for candidates who are technically skilled and familiar with embedded Linux and RTOS. We are expanding in all time zones, so we can accommodate candidates from almost any country as long as they have reasonable business access to a substantial market territory in person. As we grow our teams, we will also hire Sales Team Managers and Regional Sales Directors. Please continue with this process if your goal is a management leadership position.
The server edition of Ubuntu is already very widely used in connected devices and industrial PCs. Our newer edition of Ubuntu for IoT, called Ubuntu Core, represents the state of the art in security and resilience for high-end appliances and equipment. Our customers include global brands in consumer and industrial electronics, as well as automotive and robotics. We continue to expand our range of offerings to bring our security, management, and developer experience to the smallest Linux environments and devices. We recently added a real-time Linux capability and are working towards a range of certifications for these offerings. Together, this portfolio is Linux reinvented for optimal reliability, security, developer productivity, and footprint.
This is a prospecting sales and strategic account development role and requires energy, ambition, and focus. To be successful, you must be comfortable positioning and selling open source, services, and software solutions to all levels of an organization, and specifically to departments that are developing embedded software and IoT devices. You should also be familiar with at least one of our priority sectors.
Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute, and every category of application. Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting, and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote, and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.
We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position; it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision-making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long-term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world-leading company, we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment that promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration, and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.
In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers
Ubuntu is already very widely adopted, which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with brands in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement, and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgment as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete, and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.
The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies, and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.
Location: We are growing our sales reach in all regions - EMEA, APAC, and Americas.
The role entails
  • Building and executinge a territory plan to prioritize leading security-focused brands and manufacturers
  • Working with marketing to promote our brand and increase market awareness in prioritized accounts
  • Developing pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Closinge contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets and achieve strategic objectives
  • Managinge customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Working with IoT Field Engineers to understand customer requirements and ensure customer satisfaction
  • Maintaining accurate data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establishing productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision-makers
  • Coordinatinge with colleagues, including support, delivery, and management
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Field sales experience in embedded Linux, embedded software, or enterprise software
  • Track record of achievement of sales targets and large account wins
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% for customer meetings and industry events
  • Ability to develop and execute territory sales plans
  • Detail oriented with effective follow-up
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave

  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Overview

AI Engineer – Data & Automation (Healthcare SaaS)

About Us

AMX Healthcare is building a new SaaS platform to transform how healthcare staffing is managed—connecting clients, contractors, and job opportunities with speed and compliance. We’re investing in AI to streamline recruiting, automate data flows, and surface insights from our knowledge base (resumes, job descriptions, Confluence, ATS / CRM, etc.).

Role Overview

We’re hiring an AI Engineer – Data & Automation to design and build intelligent systems that bring structure, insight, and automation to our staffing workflows. You’ll turn unstructured data (resumes, job descriptions, documents, chats) into actionable intelligence using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) , document intelligence , and structured extraction . This is a founding role to develop and own the AI function —defining architecture, best practices, and solutions that become foundational for our platform and business.

The Impact

  • Time-to-fill ↓ 30–50% : OCR → parse → validate → post touches from hours to minutes.
  • Zero-drama compliance : Primary-source checks, expirations, and audit logs built in.
  • Revenue & margin ↑ : Accurate pay-package math and cleaner timesheets reduce adjustments / write-offs.
  • Cash flow ↑ : Invoice creation from approved time, automated AR, and payroll sync reduce DSO and billing errors.
  • Recruiter capacity ↑ : AI SMS cadences and clean data flows speed shortlists and follow-through.
  • Decision speed : Live Sheets / Excel / Power BI replaces weekly spreadsheet marathons.
  • Platform rigor : MLOps, observability, and cost governance keep AI stable, safe, and affordable.

What You’ll Build

  • Document AI pipelines : OCR → classify → extract → validate → post for licenses, immunizations, I-9s, background checks, timesheets, and offers. Enforce strict JSON schemas, confidence scores, and text-span provenance.
  • Compliance automation : Primary-source license checks, date / format rules, name / DOB matching, immunization logic, and timesheet math (REG / OT).
  • Workflow integrations : Event-driven APIs / webhooks across Applicant Tracking Systems , healthcare compliance platforms , job boards , CRM / Marketing systems (e.g., HubSpot or Salesforce ), and Task Management Tools (e.g., Jira, Zoom Tasks).
  • Text message (SMS) automation : AI-assisted campaigns and cadences (opt-in, nurture, reactivation) triggered from ATS / CRM events; personalize copy, schedule sends, ingest replies / MMS docs, and auto-log to the system of record.
  • Comms → system of record : Integrate VoIP / SMS (e.g., RingCentral, TextUs, BeeTexting) with ATS / Compliance to auto-log activity, attach files, and trigger workflows.
  • Customer support & knowledge base automation : Zendesk + knowledge base workflows—AI triage / routing, macro suggestions, agent-assist via RAG with citations, chatbot deflection, and SLA dashboards.
  • Marketing & CMS automation : Content workflows with Jasper AI ; landing / job content in HubSpot CMS , Webflow , or WordPress .
  • Pay package automation : Bill rates + stipends + guaranteed hours → weekly packages with audit trails.
  • Finance, accounting & payroll automation (required) : Integrations with QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools to :
  • Generate invoices from approved time, bill rates, and contract terms; handle credits / adjustments.
  • Sync AR / AP, post journal entries, reconcile payments; surface exceptions for review.
  • Automate payroll prep from timesheets and pay packages; route exceptions to HITL queues with full auditability.
  • Knowledge assistants : RAG chatbots over Confluence / SharePoint / Drive / ATS / CRM with permissions, citations, and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Live reporting : Streams to Google Sheets , Excel , and Power BI for exceptions, credential heatmaps, ready-to-work rosters, AR aging, and payroll variance.

MLOps & Platform

  • Dataset / prompt / embedding versioning; golden test sets; offline / online evals; A / B tests.
  • CI / CD for data and models; rollbacks; feature flags; latency / reliability SLOs; canary / blue-green.
  • Durable orchestration and state (idempotency, retries / backoff, dead-letter handling).
  • Observability (traces / metrics / cost), drift detection, PII / HIPAA redaction, RBAC, audit logs.
  • Cost governance : token / throughput controls, caching / TTL, embedding reuse, batching, FinOps reporting.

Must-Have

  • Strong software engineering in Python and / or C# .
  • Hands-on LLM / RAG (embeddings, retrieval, prompt design, evaluation).
  • Document ingestion at scale (PDF / HTML / images), schema’d extraction, validation.
  • Secure, auditable data design ( HIPAA / PII ), APIs / webhooks, event-driven workflows.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems (ATS / Compliance / Job Boards / HubSpot / Salesforce ).
  • Experience integrating QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools for automated invoicing / payroll with audit trails.
  • MLOps fundamentals : data / model versioning, CI / CD, monitoring, rollback.

Nice-to-Have

  • Healthcare staffing / credentialing domain.
  • Resume parsing APIs (Sovren, Textkernel, Affinda) or document intelligence services.
  • iPaaS / workflow tools (Zapier / Make), queues, human-in-the-loop review UIs.
  • Deploying AI apps on managed cloud (AKS / App Service or equivalents).
  • Information retrieval, knowledge graphs, or NLP research background.
  • Prior work on compliance-heavy systems (healthcare, finance, government).
  • Zendesk automation; Jasper AI content ops; CMS automation (HubSpot CMS, Webflow, WordPress).
  • Contributions to open-source AI / LLM frameworks or a strong portfolio of shipped AI projects.

Why AMX

  • Founding scope & ownership : Build the AI function—architecture, standards, roadmap.
  • Executive air cover : Direct line to the Head of Engineering; CEO-level sponsorship to ship.
  • Modern, open stack : Integrations across ATS, compliance, job boards, CRM / Marketing (HubSpot / Salesforce) , VoIP / SMS, CMS, accounting / payroll , and reporting—pick the best tool for the job.
  • Mission-critical outcomes : Help clinicians reach the bedside faster with fewer errors—visible impact on placements, revenue, compliance, cash conversion, and payroll accuracy.
  • Remote-first, pragmatic culture : Production over prototypes, HIPAA / PII first, human-in-the-loop where it matters.

EEO

AMX Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

title: Cientista de Dados Especialista - Programação (RJ)
description:
Cientista de Dados Especialista - Programação (RJ)

LiveMode Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Join to apply for the Cientista de Dados Especialista - Programação (RJ) role at LiveMode

O que nos move?

Claro, a paixão por esportes é indiscutível, mas também somos grandes amantes de inovação constante! Buscamos soluções digitais que conectem clubes, federações, ligas e marcas ao público de forma eficaz e inovadora. Nosso objetivo é construir um ecossistema que sustente o esporte nas próximas décadas, integrando o melhor do digital e da TV. É assim que estamos fazendo história e queremos encontrar mais pessoas que acreditem no potencial do que estamos construindo e queiram fazer parte disso.

Dito isso, estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar como Cientista de Dados Especialista para jogar junto à nossa equipe de Programação no Rio de Janeiro. Na LiveMode, cada movimento é uma jogada para a liderança e inovação no mercado.

Como Cientista de Dados Especialista , sua missão será a análise e definição de metas de audiência com base em dados, geração de insights acionáveis e automação de processos, desenvolvendo relatórios e dashboards estratégicos para orientar decisões de produto, comercial e programação. Impulsionando não apenas nossa presença no mercado, mas também a forma como o esporte é vivenciado globalmente.

Responsabilidades:

  • Análise de audiência e definição de metas: monitorar os dados de transmissões ao vivo e grades de programação, identificando horários e formatos com melhor desempenho; definir metas para eventos com base em análises históricas e variáveis relevantes; cruzar diferentes bases de dados para gerar insights que embasem metas comerciais e de produto.
  • Geração de insights acionáveis: transformar dados complexos em planos de ação práticos para áreas como comercial, produto e planejamento; trazer insights ainda não explorados que contribuam para a otimização da audiência e da performance geral das transmissões; investigar quedas de audiência e propor soluções fundamentadas em dados.
  • Automação e processamento de dados: desenvolver automações para relatórios e análises que hoje são feitos manualmente, utilizando Python, Excel avançado, Power BI e ferramentas de IA (como ChatGPT) para ganho de eficiência; estruturar bases de dados que permitam análises mais ágeis e profundas.
  • Criação e apresentação de relatórios: elaborar relatórios e dashboards que contem a história por trás dos dados, resumindo informações de forma clara e objetiva; adaptar a comunicação dos resultados para diferentes públicos, desde equipes operacionais até alta liderança.
  • Testes e implementação de ferramentas: participar da implantação de novas plataformas de distribuição e análise de audiência, assegurando integração com outras áreas e consistência nas métricas acompanhadas.
  • Relacionamento com áreas internas via dados: atuar em conjunto com planejamento comercial, produtos e distribuição, servindo como elo de conexão baseado em dados; negociar metas e decisões estratégicas utilizando argumentos sólidos e análises estatísticas.
  • Atuação analítica e estatística: interpretar dados complexos para identificar padrões e tendências, aplicando conceitos de estatística e análise preditiva na definição de estratégias de programação e audiência.
  • Flexibilidade operacional em grandes eventos: acompanhar transmissões e assumir responsabilidades analíticas e de monitoramento em finais de semana e eventos esportivos de relevância, garantindo qualidade na leitura dos dados em tempo real.
Requisitos necessários:
  • Perfil altamente analítico: capacidade de interpretar métricas complexas e transformá-las em planos estratégicos.
  • Ferramentas e programação: conhecimento básico de Python e SQL. Excel avançado e PowerPoint; experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados como Power BI, Looker Studio ou similares.
  • Estatística e análise preditiva: conhecimento em estatística aplicada, manipulação de dados e identificação de padrões de audiência.
  • Comunicação baseada em dados: habilidade para construir narrativas claras com dados e defender metas junto a diferentes públicos.
  • Sensibilidade esportiva: compreensão do contexto dos jogos e eventos para interpretar e contextualizar os dados.
  • Organização e gestão de múltiplas demandas: capacidade de priorizar atividades e lidar com situações de alta pressão.
  • Inglês intermediário: proficiência para comunicação em reuniões com equipes internacionais.
  • Exploração ativa de IA e automações: interesse e prática prévia com ferramentas de IA generativa (ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, automações via IA etc.), demonstrando uso no dia a dia acadêmico ou pessoal.
Diferenciais desejáveis:
  • Formação ou experiência em estatística ou ciência de dados: bagagem acadêmica ou prática em áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência no mercado esportivo: atuação anterior em programação, análise de dados ou projetos ligados a clubes, transmissões ou scouting.
  • Automação de relatórios e processos: histórico de criação de pipelines de dados e dashboards gerenciais.
  • Visão comercial aplicada a dados: habilidade para planejar grades e estratégias de programação com foco em maximizar retorno de audiência e receita.
  • Perfil proativo e colaborativo: facilidade em atuar de forma integrada e em construir soluções em conjunto com múltiplas áreas.
Nossos benefícios:
  • Auxílio Alimentação de R$ 1.250,00 por mês, para utilização em restaurantes, mercados, aplicativos de comida e outros estabelecimentos físicos ou online.
  • Vale Transporte (opcional) caso opte pelo benefício, haverá desconto de 6% do salário bruto, conforme previsto na CLT.
  • Plano de Saúde (Especial – SulAmérica) sem custo mensal para o colaborador, com coparticipação de 10% em consultas e exames. É permitida a inclusão de dependentes (cônjuge e filhos), com custos por conta do colaborador e mesma coparticipação.
  • Plano Odontológico (Mais DOC) sem custo mensal para o colaborador para o plano "Mais Doc", com possibilidade de migração para outros planos (diferença de valor descontada em folha) e inclusão de dependentes (cônjuge e filhos), com desconto em folha.
  • TotalPass e Wellhub (opcionais) o colaborador pode escolher a plataforma que melhor atender às suas necessidades. Ambas oferecem acesso a academias de diversas modalidades, esportes variados e aplicativos de saúde física, mental e financeira.
  • Auxílio-Creche para filhos de até 5 anos e 11 meses, com reembolso de despesas em creches, escolas ou com profissional regularizado (babá ou autônomo).
  • Auxílio para Dependentes PCD para colaboradores que apoiam pessoas com deficiência, mediante apresentação de laudo médico.
  • Seguro de Vida (Prudential) é uma proteção financeira para o colaborador e seus beneficiários em momentos de adversidade.
  • SESC oferece acesso a atividades culturais, esportivas, de lazer, saúde e educação, incentivando um estilo de vida saudável e equilibrado.
  • Open English oferece acesso a cursos de inglês ou espanhol em diversos formatos, com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores e familiares.
Nossa cultura

Na LiveMode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte , e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. Quem está na LiveMode está aqui para marcar a história do esporte no Brasil e no Mundo.

SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES ontim, hoje e sempre

Escolhemos o gol e corremos atrás dele com tudo. Focamos em poucas prioridades e vamos até o fim, sem distrações. Tratamos cada recurso como se fosse nosso, decidindo rápido e com coragem. Comunicação? Direta, aberta e na velocidade do jogo.

SOMOS UM TIME DE ALTA PERFORMANCE não uma família ou uma confraria de amigos

Família a gente não escolhe, mas o time escolhe quem joga. E quando o jogo é grande, não dá pra carregar quem não tá entregando. Aqui, a gente decide pelo que é melhor pra empresa, não pra uma área ou pessoa. Toda entrega tem um dono claro, que vai até o fim. Processos ajudam, mas não mandam: quem resolve são as pessoas.

SOMOS AMBICIOSOS pensamos sempre grande

A gente já fez muita coisa grande. Mas quem está na LiveMode sabe que dá pra ir além. Porque quem é ambicioso de verdade vive com a sensação de que sempre dá pra melhorar, crescer, fazer mais impacto. Aqui, a ambição não é discurso. É prática. E é ela que nos leva a quebrar recorde atrás de recorde.

O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO

Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. Por isso, tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos com velocidade. Queremos ser uma empresa IA first, porque acreditamos que dominar essas ferramentas não é opcional — é o que vai nos ajudar a alcançar nossa missão mais rápido. IA não é extra. É parte central do nosso dia a dia.

title: BANCO DE TALENTOS - EXCLUSIVO PARA PESSOA COM DEFICIÊNCIA
description:
A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e municipal, conforme decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

Atuando nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, a instituição promove políticas de saúde e educação, além de ser uma organização social habilitada em vários estados, gerenciando serviços e organizações de saúde por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A principal diretriz da associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde, voltada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e promoção da saúde em níveis primário, secundário e terciário, fortalecendo laços com a comunidade local e atendendo a todos sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento institucional, a SPDM amplia suas ações com projetos em andamento na área de Assistência Social e Educação, consolidando-se como uma grande instituição filantrópica que busca sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências — Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação — são gerenciadas por profissionais altamente capacitados.

Disponibilizamos um banco de talentos exclusivo para profissionais com deficiência. Inscreva-se para ser direcionado às vagas disponíveis conforme suas qualificações!

  • Formação de acordo com a área de interesse;
  • Experiência mínima de 6 meses na área;
  • Salário + Benefícios;
  • Escala e horário de trabalho a serem definidos;
  • Locais de trabalho: Zona Norte, Oeste e Centro do Rio de Janeiro;
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores ou prestadores de serviço, com vínculo de parentesco ou atuação em modalidades contratuais diferentes, devem consultar as normativas de RH vigentes junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM é uma associação reconhecida por sua atuação social e compromisso com a saúde pública, promovendo ações integradas com a gestão pública, visando garantir acesso universal à saúde, com equipes multiprofissionais de alta qualificação, incluindo enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades em 2001 na cidade de São Paulo, expandindo-se para outros municípios e estados, buscando melhorar indicadores de saúde e qualidade de vida da população, pautado na integralidade e equidade.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho com plano de carreira para pessoas com deficiência em suas unidades hospitalares, realizando periodicamente anúncios de recrutamento nos principais jornais das regiões de atuação.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas à gestão pública, de forma ética, humanizada, com qualidade técnica e compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência na gestão de serviços em saúde, garantindo atendimento de qualidade a toda a população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Overview

Solvd is a rapidly growing AI-native consulting and technology services firm delivering enterprise transformation across cloud, data, software engineering, and artificial intelligence. Our capability centers combine deep technical expertise, proven delivery methodologies, and sector-specific knowledge to address complex business challenges quickly and effectively.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Business Analyst with strong expertise in end-to-end business analysis . This role requires someone who can effectively collaborate with stakeholders, facilitate requirement discovery, and ensure that business needs are translated into high-quality solutions. The ideal candidate will have proven experience in pre-sales activities and the ability to contribute directly to client delivery projects. When not engaged in active delivery, the candidate will support pre-sales initiatives, including proposal development, discovery sessions, and solution shaping, and may be considered for involvement in CMS-related projects. In addition, the candidate should be technically savvy, with a solid understanding of system solution design and its core components, including backend services, frontend applications, APIs, and integrations.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate across stakeholder groups to gather, analyze, and document requirements at all stages of the project lifecycle (from initiation/discovery through development and maintenance).
  • Communicate directly with customers to elicit high-level requirements and convert them into detailed documentation such as Vision & Scope, SRS, User Stories, Use Cases, UML diagrams, and process flows.
  • Develop and maintain product backlogs (epics, features, user stories) to guide Agile development teams.
  • Facilitate workshops and decision-making sessions to align customer expectations and technical delivery.
  • Execute impact-mapping of requirements and manage change requests throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Lead verification of designs against requirements, providing recommendations to resolve any issues.
  • Support PMs with timelines, roadmaps, milestones, and sprint planning.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in Jira, Confluence/other tools.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience across the full BA cycle (pre-sales, discovery, delivery, and support).
  • Strong ability to elicit, document, and manage requirements using BA artifacts (Vision & Scope, SRS, User Stories, Use Cases, diagrams, etc.).
  • Experience with impact mapping and change request management.
  • Skilled in backlog management, sprint planning, and Agile delivery support.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Confident in facilitating workshops, leading meetings, and driving decision-making.
  • Strong command of English (B2+/C1 level).
  • Proficiency with Jira, Confluence or similar tools.
  • Ability to work independently (the only BA on the project) and collaboratively in a BA team environment.
  • Motivated, proactive, and passionate about customer success and growth.
  • Experienced in supporting multicultural, distributed teams.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with AI/ML, or digital transformation projects.
  • BA certifications (CBAP, CCBA, Agile BA, PO, etc.).

What you’ll get

  • Shape real-world AI-driven projects across key industries, working with clients from startup innovation to enterprise transformation.
  • Be part of a global team with equal opportunities for collaboration across continents and cultures.
  • Thrive in an inclusive environment that prioritizes continuous learning, innovation, and ethical AI standards.

Ready to make an impact? If you’re excited to build things that matter, champion responsible AI, and grow with some of the industry’s sharpest minds, apply today and let’s innovate together.

We regularly solve interesting, technical problems. From triaging complex Cloud environment issues, Linux kernel crashes we've never seen before to OS configuration issues and root cause analysis, we provide an expert level of support and satisfaction to our peer groups and customers. We are rapidly expanding and are looking for talented problem solvers with a passion for working on the next generation of Ubuntu solutions for our customers.

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

    • Virtualization / Cloud - primarily using KVM or OpenStack.
    • Containers - especially with Docker, LXD/LXC, or Kubernetes.
    • Storage technologies - block, object and network.
    • Networking (bonding, firewalling, bridging, switching, network file system tuning, MTU issues, etc.).
  • Cloud computing expertise in provisioning, monitoring, orchestration, etc.
  • Advanced troubleshooting experience:
    • Linux integration with other environments (authentication/directory services, network file systems, etc.).
    • Ability to navigate effectively stack traces and logs, and advise on next steps.
    • Solid understanding of OS and Application level bugs and when to escalate to the correct team.
  • Programming fundamentals in any language.
  • Extensive Customer support experience is key:
    • Customer needs are top priority.
    • Communicate professionally, emphatically, clearly and set the right expectations.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

description:

APM Terminals

Business Unit: APM Terminals

Locations: Itajai, Pecem, Suape Brazil (remote flexibility)

PURPOSE

APM Terminals, a global leader in port and terminal operations and part of the A.P. Moller-Maersk Group, is committed to delivering world-class container handling, logistics solutions, and maritime services. With operations in over 70 countries, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence, all while driving sustainable growth and making a positive impact on communities worldwide.

At APM Terminals, we offer exceptional opportunities for personal and professional development in a diverse and inclusive environment. Join us as we shape the future of global trade and redefine industry standards.

The Global DBA Engineer role is responsible for the performance, integrity, security, and availability of databases within the organization. The role encompasses both strategic and operational duties, including the efficient storage of data, maintaining access reliability, and protection against data loss or unauthorized access. The DBA will collaborate closely with terminal and regional infrastructure teams to uphold current standards, implement robust backup and recovery policies, and carry out database tuning and performance monitoring to support business continuity and system optimization.

Principle Accountabilities

  • We are looking for DBA with experience mainly in SQL-Server.
  • Install and maintain the performance of database servers.
  • Install and maintain HA scenarios AON, replication.
  • Knowledge of database security, backup and recovery, and performance monitoring standards
  • Develop processes for optimizing database security.
  • Set and maintain database standards.
  • Manage database access.
  • Performance tuning of database systems.
  • Install, upgrade, and manage database applications.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot database errors.
  • Triage reported issues to accurately identify, escalate, and respond to urgent or critical matters in support of terminal operations.
  • Identify root causes of outages and issues and prepare plans for permanent changes to eliminate/reduce chronic issues or establish SOPs for resolution by ‘shift left’ resources
  • Recommend and implement emerging database technologies.
  • Create and manage database reports, visualizations, and dashboards.
  • Create automation for repeating database tasks.
  • Work with the Global N4 Migration Team on all N4 upgrades.
  • Document implementation & deployment plans
  • Be available for on-call support as needed.
  • Valuable Oracle DBA experience
  • In cooperation with TOS app, deliver 24x7x365 (follow the sun) support to end users and system consumers N4 and related applications. Expand support model to all locations globally.

Critical Qualifications/Skills/Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field preferred
  • 2- 3 years of experience in database administration, information technology, database architecture, or a related field
  • MCSE/MCSA certifications preferred
  • Experience with Windows Server environments preferred
  • Good communication skills
  • English. Spanish is valuable.
  • Adaptable to different cultures.
  • Willingness and availability to travel.

Sobre a Empresa

Cuidando de você, sempre!

Somos a Drogaria Venancio, uma marca carioca que, há mais de 45 anos, coloca o cuidado no centro de tudo o que faz. Com mais de 135 lojas físicas e ao mesmo tempo mais de 4.900 colaboradores, estamos presentes em diversos bairros do Rio de Janeiro e municípios como Niterói, São Gonçalo, Duque de Caxias, Angra dos Reis, Nova Iguaçu, São João de Meriti, Petrópolis, Teresópolis, Búzios e Volta Redonda.

Além disso, nossos canais digitais ampliam nossa atuação para mais de 10 estados, levando saúde, beleza e bem-estar a milhares de clientes em todo o Brasil.

Nosso propósito? Cuidar das pessoas de forma acessível, humanizada e inovadora. Acreditamos que saúde vai além dos medicamentos: é qualidade de vida, prevenção e bem-estar.

Em 2014, criamos a Hospinova, empresa do Grupo Venancio focada no mercado hospitalar e na distribuição farmacêutica, garantindo um serviço especializado e eficiente. Para sustentar nosso crescimento, contamos com três Centros de Distribuição, estrategicamente localizados no Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo e Belo Horizonte.

O que nos torna únicos? Nossa essência carioca, o acolhimento genuíno e a busca constante pela inovação. Valorizamos o capital humano, investimos na capacitação de nossos times e ganhamos com ética, transparência e simplicidade. Aqui, cada cliente é prioridade e cada detalhe importante.

A Venancio não para! Até o final de 2025, inauguraremos mais 23 lojas e continuaremos expandindo nossa presença no mercado, sempre com o compromisso de oferecer atendimento de excelência e soluções completas para o bem-estar de nossos clientes.

Se você compartilha da nossa paixão por cuidar de pessoas, venha crescer com a gente!

title: MÉDICO OFTALMOLOGISTA (CATARATA) - CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO
description:
Resumo

O CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO está localizado na região central da cidade, no Bairro de Benfica. Os serviços prestados abrangem toda a população carioca. É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.

Serviços oferecidos

  • diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas
  • realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual
  • avaliação da condução nervosa do estímulo visual e das deficiências do campo visual
  • programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão
  • ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde
  • realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação

Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar a fim de garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e, das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade. Acompanhar, analisar e tratar os relatórios e atendimentos necessários para o cumprimento das metas, prazos e melhorias.
  • Realizar atividades na especialidade de oftalmologia, prevenir, diagnosticar e tratar das doenças e distúrbios dos olhos e visão, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal de Saúde.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina. Residência Médica, Título de Especialista em Oftalmologia, Registro de Qualificação de Especialidade (RQE);
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada como Médico Oftalmologista;
  • Especialista em Segmento Posterior com comprovante de Estágio (Fellowship) em Catarata.

Condições de Trabalho

  • Local de Trabalho: Benfica - RJ
  • Carga Horária: 12h semanais
  • Regime de contratação: CLT
  • Observação: Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.
  • Avaliação por competências

Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde PAIS

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Missão

Missão Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Visão Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.
